summary: Reproduced the independent review against candidate 8a5abc997a9d05264d4349a9d62fd0fc7d4ee630. Dense BF16 MTP construction with a broad Linear W4A8 target and no ignore still raises before checkpoint tensors are visible. Preserved the candidate's actionable diagnostic and packed-layer safety boundary, corrected its invalid plain-glob documentation, and added regression coverage for both MTP prefix forms. No automatic fallback was added because construction cannot distinguish dense .weight storage from genuinely quantized weight_packed/weight_scale storage.

remaining_limitations: Dense MTP weights without an explicit valid ignore entry still fail construction; this correction makes the failure actionable and documents the valid regex but does not claim to resolve no-ignore startup.

Actual packed MTP checkpoint loading was not exercised. Dense and packed tensor inventories cannot affect the common pre-load construction point, and no model weights were available to verify the later load path.
No full Qwen3-Next checkpoint or original 2x H100 NVL TP2/EP2 environment was available, so end-to-end NEXTN server startup remains unverified.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
